# Version 4.156.0 (Unreleased)
> **Platform and performance updates**

## Highlights

The upcoming SkiaSharp 4.156 release improves platform support, rendering synchronization, and managed image and text performance. It adds Uno Platform 7 support, raises Apple deployment minimums, and corrects native string and stream lifetime handling.

## Breaking Changes

- **Apple deployment minimums raised** — Apple applications must target the newer deployment minimums required by this release before upgrading. ([#5383](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5383))

## Engine

- **Latest m156 fixes incorporated** — Updates the bundled m156 renderer with the latest upstream bug fixes and toolchain refresh. ([#5420](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5420), [#5489](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5489))

## Bug Fixes

- **Native string creation no longer reads beyond its input buffer** — SKData string creation writes directly to managed data storage, correcting native buffer handling. ([#5429](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5429))
- **Front-buffered streams no longer retain stale data** — Corrects front-buffered stream retention to release data when it is no longer needed. ([#5327](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5327))
- **Android texture rendering follows the display refresh** — Synchronizes Android texture rendering with display refresh timing for smoother presentation. ([#5345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5345))

## Platform

- **Uno Platform 7 is supported** — Builds SkiaSharp.Views.Uno.WinUI against Uno Platform 7. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5377](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5377))
- **WebGPU native code is included in SkiaSharp** — Packages emdawnwebgpu's webgpu.cpp within libSkiaSharp.a for WebGPU consumers. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5316](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5316))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Image and text processing allocate less** — Optimizes managed pixel copies, pools HarfBuzz UTF-32 encoding buffers, and avoids native feature-string allocations. ([#5052](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5052), [#5060](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5060), [#5230](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5230))
